title: Gatekeeper Onboarding Checklist and Notes — Feb 28 2028
summary: Working notes for the "Gatekeeper" onboarding slice: align eval gating criteria, telemetry requirements, and a minimal checklist so models can graduate from staging -> dedicated. Focus areas this week: per-token delta monitoring, compact quant behavior across 4-bit paths, and lightweight synthetic eval harness for fast regressions.
notes: Context and problem: we keep seeing subtle 4-bit quantization regressions that only surface in long prompts or when KV reuse hits certain patterns. Goal is a repeatable gate with clear metrics so product Canary and Dedicated rollout teams can autotriage.
meeting_notes: Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Emily, Jonas, Priya (SRE). Quick status: Marco landed the microbatcher fix; Emily has new eval harness (fast-sim) but it's missing streaming hooks; Jonas instrumented per-request KV-hit telemetry.
observations:
- 4-bit config 'q4_kv_light' has consistent perplexity bump at prompt lengths >1024 for instruction-following tasks.
- KV cache re-use patterns amplify logit drift when combined with temperature >1.2.
- Existing smoke eval (10k prompts) misses these because sample set lacks long-context dialogues.
- Telemetry shows an uptick in small but persistent token-level entropy increases starting at token 240 in some user traces.
experiments:
Planned experiments for next sprint:
1) Long-context synthetic suite: generate 2.5k dialogues with escalating turn length, run q8/q4/q4_kv_light and compare token-accuracy curves.
2) KV-prefetch latency vs. correctness: toggle prefetch on/off with microbatch sizes [1,4,8] to see correlation.
3) Token-delta alert sensitivity: tune alert thresholds to avoid false positives from benign entropy variance.
Notes: keep seed bank stable, record full logits for first 512 tokens, metric: cumulative token accuracy drop and first-token-shift index.
decisions:
- Temporarily gate q4_kv_light for production routing when expected context >1024.
- Add 'long-context' label to the model catalog that will automatically prefer q8 for safety.
- Finalize and merge fast-sim eval harness by Mar 4; must include streaming hooks and logging at token granularity.
open_questions:
- How noisy is the token-entropy signal across real user traffic vs synthetic? Need SRE sampling plan.
- Do we want to expose 'context-aware' flags in the Hosted API or keep routing internal?
- Is there a performance penalty for enabling additional per-token telemetry in Dedicated customers?

retro_snippets: What worked: fast turnaround on microbatch fix; clear owner breakdown. What didn't: eval set coverage, missing streaming hooks. Next time: add probe prompts to standard smoke tests and include 'long-context' seeds in nightly runs.
